paragraphs.text: # dsh-plugins
DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugins, one package per directory under `packages/`.
| Package | What it does |
| `dsh-system-prefix` | Prepends one configurable sentence to a new top-level session's system promp

t without replacing anything else. |
| `dsh-system-md` | A project's `.dsh/SYSTEM.md` replaces the w

hole built-in system prompt for that project's sessions. |
| `dsh-ptc-human-wait` | The `run_code` e

xecution deadline pauses while a nested `ask_user_question` waits for the user. |
| `dsh-desktop-not
ify-live` | Windows toast notification and a ding when the agent asks a question or a turn finishes.

|
| `dsh-mail-bridge` | Emails each finished turn and every pending question to your phone; replyin
g to the email continues the session. |
